THE PROCESS OF LOWERING THE STREET LEVELS RESULTED IN THE CITY CREATING RETAINING WALLS ALONG SIDEWALKS AND THE VERY DANGEROUS ASPECT OF SIDEWALK STEPS OR STAIRS AT STREET CORNERS.  RECENTLY, THE CITY HAS COMPLETED REBUILDING RETAINING WALLS AND SIDEWALKS IN SOME AREAS OF BEAUREGARD TOWN, BUT NOT THE MOST DANGEROUS LOCATIONS, AND CONTINUES TO REPLACE SIDEWALKS IN OTHER AREAS OF DOWNTOWN.  CLEARLY, FROM AN EXISTENCE STANDPOINT, THERE CAN BE NOTHING MORE DANGEROUS FOR HANDICAPPED PEOPLE, PEDESTRIANS, CYCLISTS OR PARENTS PUSHING A STROLLER WITH AN INFANT THAN SIDEWALK STEPS OR STAIRS, ESPECIALLY AT NIGHT. TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN,     I AM WRITING THIS FORMAL LETTER, BECAUSE ALL OF MY OTHER CORRESPONDENCE OVER THE YEARS HAVE NOT BEEN ADDRESSED.  I HAVE BEEN INFORMED BY LEGAL COUNSEL TO SEND IN THIS FORMAL COMPLAINT, TO GIVE YOU TIME TO RESPOND. PLEASE BE ADVISED THAT THIS CORRESPONDENCE HAS BEEN SENT TO OTHER CITY OFFICIALS AS WELL.    THIS LETTER COMES IN REFENCE TO THE VACANT EMPTY LOT, NEXT TO MY HOME AT 6745 GLEN OAKS DR.   (THIS LOT HAS BEEN OWNED BY THE CITY FOR THE LAST 15 YEARS)    THIS LOT HAS BEEN A DANGER TO MY HOME FOR MANY YEARS AND AFTER MAKING SEVERAL 311 CALLS AND COMPLAINING THE PROBLEM, AND NO ACTION WAS EVER TAKEN TO CORRECT THE PROBLEM WITH THIS TREE, THE PROBLEM HAS NOW BECOME A BIGGER SITUATION. NEGLECT ISSUE: DUE THE NEGLECT OF THIS PROPERTY OVER THE YEARS, A TREE HAS NOW DAMAGED MY PROPERTY AND I HAVE HAD TO SPEND MONEY TO FIX MY MAIN PLUMBING LINE DUE TO THE ROOTS GROWING INTO MY FOUNDATION, I HAVE HAD TO HAVE MY ROOF FIXED SEVERAL TIMES BECAUSE OF THE LARGE BRANCHES FALLING ON MY ROOF, CAUSING HOLES THAT HAD TO BE REPAIRED. MYSELF  ALONG  WITH MY NEIGHBORS  , HAVE  BEEN  MOWING, PICKING  UP  TRASH , ETC. ON THIS  LOT  FOR  OVER  15 YEARS. I  HAD  TO  WRITE  A  FORMAL  COMPLAINT  BACK  IN  2015  JUST  TO GET THE  CITY  TO  COME  A  MOW  THE  LAWN  BECAUSE  IT HAD WAS  SO  BAD  WE  AS  A  COMMUNITY  DID  NOT HAVE  THE  PROPER  EQUIPMENT  TO TAKE  CARE  OF  THIS. IN THE  LAST  15 YEARS  I  CAN  COUNT  THE  TIMES  THIS  PROPERTY  HAS  BEEN SERVICED BY THE CITY.  TREE ISSUE: THIS TREE IS A VERY LARGE TREE, AND IT’S EVENTUALLY GOING TO FALL ON MY HOME.   BRANCHES HAVE FELL ON MY ROOF, BRANCHES HAVE FELL ON MY FENCE AND I KEEP HAVING TO SPEND MONEY TO REPLACE THIS EVERY STORM SEASON.  EVERY HURRICANE SEASON I LIVE IN FEAR THAT THIS   TREE WILL FALL, IT’S NOT A MATTER OF IF, IT’S A MATTER OF WHEN.   SOMEONE CAME OVER LAST YEAR (2020) AND DUG UP THE SLAB ON THIS VACANT LOT AND NOW WATER IS OVERFLOWING IN MY YARD AS WELL AS MY NEIGHBOR’S YARD.  AND THIS WHEN IT RAINS WATER SETS UP IN THIS LOT, AND THERE ARE SNAKES OVER THERE IN THAT WATER AND WE HAVE KIDS IN THIS NEIGHBOR, THIS IS A PROBLEM. THIS MATTER NEEDS TO ADDRESS IMMEDIATELY.  THIS TREE NEEDS TO BE TAKEN DOWN BEFORE IT FALLS AND SOMEONE GET HURT, AND BEFORE IT DOES ANY MORE DAMAGE TO MY HOME.   COMMUNITY  ISSUE: AS I DO UNDERSTAND THAT “URBAN” NEIGHBORHOODS AND COMMUNITIES ARE NOT TOP PRIORITY, BUT WE ARE HOMEOWNERS AND WE PAY TAXES JUST LIKE EVERYONE ELSE, AND WE SHOULD RECEIVE THE SAME SERVICE AS ANY OTHER COMMUNITY. I HAVE ENCLOSED PICTURES FOR YOU TO REVIEW, AS WELL AS MY CONTACT INFORMATION. I REALLY HOPE THAT THIS MATTER WILL BE TAKEN CARE OF AND FURTHER ACTION WILL   BE  NECESSARY.   THANK YOU, LATARA

MY NAME IS DR. JAMES BOARD AND I AM THE PRESIDENT OF THE HOME OWNERS ASSOCIATION OF THE CHATSWORTH COURT CONDOMINIUM COMPLEX ON S. KENILWORTH PKWY OFF BURBANK AVE.  THE RECENT CONSTRUCTION OF THE KENILWORTH CROSSING SUBDIVISION ADJACENT TO OUR COMPLEX HAS CREATED A FLOODING THREAT TO CHATSWORTH COURT.  THE BUILDER OF KENILWORTH CROSSING SUBDIVISION HAS EXCAVATED A LARGE AREA IN BACK OF US TO INCREASE THE HEIGHT OF THE SUBDIVISIONS LAND.  A LARGE LAKE HAS FORMED IN THE EXCAVATED AREA.  THIS LAKE, IN ADDITION TO RELATIVELY HIGHER GROUND FOR KENILWORTH CROSSING COMPARED WITH CHATSWORTH COURT, HAVE CREATED A SERIOUS FLOODING PROBLEM FOR OUR COMPLEX.  I WOULD LIKE TO DEMONSTRATE THIS PROBLEM BY FIRST DRAWING YOUR ATTENTION TO IMG-1672, WHICH SHOWS AN OVERALL VIEW OF KENILWORTH CROSSING LAKE WITH THE NEW HOUSES OF THE SUBDIVISION ON THE LEFT HALF OF THE PICTURE AND THE TWO-STORY CHATSWORTH COURT CONDOMINIUM COMPLEX ON THE RIGHT HALF OF THE PICTURE.  ONE CAN SEE THAT KENILWORTH CROSSING IS ON SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER GROUND RELATIVE TO CHATSWORTH COURT.  A CLOSER EXAMINATION PRESENTS THE PROBLEM MORE CLEARLY.  IMG-1674 SHOWS THE HIGHER GROUND FOR HOMES IN KENILWORTH CROSSING RELATIVE TO THE PARKING LOT OF CHATSWORTH COURT FROM WHERE THE PICTURE WAS TAKEN.  A HEAVY RAINFALL WOULD CHANNEL WATER INTO CHATSWORTH COURT THREATENING THE CONDOMINIUMS WITH FLOODING.  PLEASE VIEW IMG-1677 WHICH SHOWS THE TWO-STORY CONDOMINIUMS OF CHATSWORTH COURT (RIGHT SIDE OF PICTURE) AT A MUCH LOWER LEVEL THAN THE HOUSES OF KENILWORTH CROSSING (LEFT SIDE OF PICTURE).  IMAGE 1680 SHOWS THE SAME PROBLEM.  CHATSWORTH COURT ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE PICTURE IS SEVERAL FEET LOWER THAN THE RAISED GROUND OF KENILWORTH CROSSING ON THE OTHER SIDE OF THE FENCE.  THE EFFECT OF THIS HEIGHT DIFFERENTIAL CAN BE SEEN IN PICTURES TAKEN DURING A RECENT HEAVY RAINFALL EVENT (IMG-2914 AND 2912).  THE KENILWORTH CROSSING LAKE ROSE CLOSE TO CONDOMINIUMS AT THE BACK OF CHATSWORTH COURT.  FLOODING ASSOCIATED WITH A MAJOR HURRICANE WOULD DEFINITELY FLOOD PARTS OF THE COMPLEX.  IN CONCLUSION, WE THINK THE CONSTRUCTION OF KENILWORTH CROSSING HAS CREATED A SERIOUS FLOODING RISK FOR CHATSWORTH COURT.  WE REQUEST THAT AUTHORITIES FOR BATON ROUGE TAKE ACTION SOLVING THIS PROBLEM BEFORE THE NEXT HURRICANE SEASON.  THANK YOU FOR YOUR CONSIDERATION OF THIS REQUEST.  DR. JAMES BOARD RETIRE LSU PROFESSOR
